titles.title: Quake3-TeamArena - Play Quake III Arena.bat (ioquake3 1.36 + baseq3)
titles.engine: id Tech 3: ioquake3 1.36 (ioquake3.x86.exe, 'ioq3 1.36 win_mingw-x86 Apr 12 2009', SDL 1.2 using its DirectX backend by default) over id's 1.32 point-release paks pak0-pak8
titles.launch_sets: 1920x1080 fullscreen on the 1080p LCDs, chosen per box at every launch. The launcher calls FLEETRES.BAT, which runs FLEETRES.EXE -cmd (EDID plus the driver's mode list); on .123/.145/.195 that gives FR_W=1920 FR_H=1080 FR_FOV=106 FR_HZ=60. The launcher then writes baseq3\fleetres.cfg (seta r_mode -1, r_customwidth, r_customheight, r_customaspect 1, r_customPixelAspect 1, r_fullscreen 1, r_displayRefresh, cg_fov) and passes the same values as +set on the ioquake3.x86.exe command line. The staged baseq3\autoexec.cfg ends with 'exec fleetres.cfg'. GAMESYNC writes the same body at sync time (agent/shared/gameres.h:685, GR_OP_CFG baseq3\fleetres.cfg). The engine honours it: R_GetModeInfo(-1) uses r_customwidth/height. Everything is present and consistent in the staged tree: FLEETRES.EXE md5 bb180f3b matches provisioning/fleetres, there is no staged seta r_mode, and no staged fleetres.cfg or q3config.cfg. PER-TITLE-STATUS records it measured on .145 (SDL_app 1920x1080). FLEETGL.BAT switches FR_ENGINE to quake3.exe only where system32\3dfxvgl.dll exists and FR_W<=800, which is never true on the LCD boxes. Caveat: .240 as currently reported (no EDID, no 1920x1080 in its driver list) cannot get 1080p from FLEETRES. That is a fault in the box, not in the title.
titles.menu_source: A hardcoded table in baseq3/pak8.pk3 vm/ui.qvm (id's 1.32 q3_ui, 2002-09-30): 320x240, 400x300, 512x384, 640x480, 800x600, 960x720, 1024x768, 1152x864, 1280x1024, 1600x1200, 2048x1536, '856x480 wide screen'. This QVM is the module that actually loads. VM_Init defaults vm_ui to "2" (compiled QVM), CL_InitUI forces the QVM whenever the server (local or remote) is pure, and nothing staged sets vm_ui. A driver-enumerated menu is already in the tree but never loaded: baseq3/uix86.dll (ioq3 1.36's build of q3_ui) reads r_availableModes. ioquake3.x86.exe DOES publish r_availableModes (CVAR_ROM, from SDL_ListModes at desktop depth, refreshed after every mode set), but the pak8 QVM never reads it. With r_mode -1 the pak8 menu shows '640x480', because SetMenuItems maps r_mode<0 to index 3. Any Apply then writes r_mode 3 unconditionally, and the session drops to 640x480 until the next launch.

titles.fix:
Smallest fix: pass '+set vm_ui 0 +set sv_pure 0' on the ioquake3 start line of Play Quake III Arena.bat. This is the combination the staged ioquake3 README documents. It makes the already-staged baseq3/uix86.dll (ioq3 1.36 q3_ui) load instead of pak8's QVM. That menu lists r_availableModes, the driver's own list, which includes 1920x1080 on these boxes. It displays the fleetres custom mode as '1920x1080', and Apply writes r_mode -1 plus r_customwidth/height for any non-builtin detected mode, so 1080p survives Apply.

Where to make the change: carry the flags in a FLEETGL.BAT variable. Set FR_UIARGS in its default ioquake3 path and clear it in the Voodoo path that switches FR_ENGINE to quake3.exe. Append %FR_UIARGS% to this launcher's start line through a repair() old->new pair in scripts/fleet/stage-fleetres.py (the same mechanism as the _REFRESH table for this title).
- Do NOT write the literal ioquake3.x86.exe into the launcher: tests/python/test_q3_voodoo2_gl.py fails on it.
- Do NOT put vm_ui into the shared baseq3/autoexec.cfg: retail quake3.exe reads it too.

Why each flag is needed:
- vm_ui is CVAR_ARCHIVE, so it persists in %APPDATA%\Quake3\baseq3\q3config.cfg, which only ioquake3 reads.
- sv_pure 0 is required because a local or skirmish game at the default sv_pure 1 is itself a pure server, and the engine then reloads the pak8 QVM.

Fleet server: in a match on quake3-server (sv_pure 1) the engine still forces the pak8 QVM, with the stock list and the Apply trap. To cover that too, set sv_pure 0 in ~/q3a-server/.q3a/baseq3/server.cfg and restart the unit; q3ta-server already runs sv_pure 0.

Alternative that also covers retail: ship the patched q3_ui ui.qvm described in the retail entry, client-side only, as baseq3/zz-fleetres-ui.pk3. ioquake3 at vm_ui 2 would load it too.
titles.fix_source: The UI module is already in the tree: baseq3/uix86.dll, the ioq3 1.36 build. The launcher change goes in the repo: scripts/fleet/stage-fleetres.py repair pair, plus the hand-staged FLEETGL.BAT and its test tests/python/test_q3_voodoo2_gl.py, then re-stage to the share. The optional server change is ~/q3a-server/.q3a/baseq3/server.cfg on the dev host. Nothing needs downloading.
titles.fix_risk:
Low to moderate.
- The native UI is the build that shipped with this exact exe, but it has never run on the fleet. Check the server browser and the Favorites tab: it uses the same server1..16 cvars, plus a multi-master browser.
- Joining servers is unaffected. A pure server forces the pak8 QVM, so the ui.qvm checksum is unchanged.
- sv_pure 0 on the client only weakens listen servers that this client hosts. After joining a pure server, that session's local sv_pure is overwritten to 1 by the server's systeminfo.
- The detected list is capped at 31 entries, sorted largest-first and then by closeness to the desktop aspect when the game started. On a 16:9 desktop 1920x1080 is first or among the first few. It could drop off only if the game starts while a stale 4:3 desktop is live and the driver offers more than 31 modes.
- Setting sv_pure 0 on quake3-server removes the server's pk3 consistency check. That is acceptable on this LAN, and q3ta-server already runs that way.
- The flags must never reach retail. With vm_ui 0, 1.32c shows a MB_TOPMOST 'Security Warning' DLL dialog (com_blindlyLoadDLLs) over the fullscreen game.
titles.hw_check:
Boxes: .123 and .145 (XP) and .195 (Win7; GDI cannot photograph exclusive fullscreen there, so use F11 = screenshotJPEG and DOWNLOAD from %APPDATA%\Quake3\baseq3\screenshots).
1. Launch: EXEC cmd /c start "" /D "C:\Games\Quake3-TeamArena" "Play Quake III Arena.bat".
2. Confirm fullscreen 1920x1080: on XP, WINLIST shows the 'ioquake3' SDL_app window at 1920x1080.
3. Open the console (UIKEY TILDE) and read:
   - the startup line: 'Loading vm file vm/ui.qvm...' today, and after the fix 'Sys_LoadDll(C:\Games\Quake3-TeamArena\baseq3\uix86.dll): succeeded';
   - 'r_availableModes': 1920x1080 must be within the first 31 entries;
   - 'r_mode': should read -1.
4. Menu: q3_ui is keyboard-navigable (arrows + ENTER; LEFT/RIGHT cycles the spin control). Go main menu > SETUP > SYSTEM > Video Mode.
   - Today it shows 640x480 while the game runs 1920x1080, and cycling offers only the 12 id modes.
   - After the fix it shows 1920x1080 and cycles the driver list. Change Texture Detail and Apply; after vid_restart, r_mode must still be -1 with r_customwidth/height 1920/1080, still fullscreen.
5. Repeat in a match: a local skirmish (ESC > SETUP > SYSTEM), and on 192.168.1.132:27961. The fleet server lists 1080p only if it runs sv_pure 0.
6. Check %APPDATA%\Quake3\baseq3 for a shadowing autoexec.cfg, or a downloaded pk3 carrying vm/ui.qvm.
7. If synthetic keys do not reach the fullscreen menu (the SDL DirectX backend reads DirectInput), navigate windowed only as a tool, then confirm the Apply result fullscreen.
8. Delete any condump output and screenshots afterwards.
titles.verifier_notes: Which UI loads was read from the binaries themselves (disassembly offsets above). The logic of the native uix86.dll menu comes from ioquake3 git and is marked web-sourced; it was spot-checked in the DLL disassembly (1024-byte buffer, 31-entry bound, Apply Cvar_Set, 0x3fe SetMenuItems buffer). Nothing was run on hardware in this phase. The pak8 Apply trap (r_mode -1 goes to 3, i.e. 640x480, on any Apply) is live today on every box, CRTs included, for both baseq3 shortcuts; the next launch restores the mode. Quake3e on the share (Files/Game Updates/quake3e.exe, 'Q3 1.32e') has 1920x1080 as r_mode 19 but no r_availableModes, so the stock UIs would still list 12 modes. It is not a menu fix.

titles.title: Quake3-TeamArena - Play Team Arena.bat (ioquake3 1.36 + fs_game missionpack)
titles.engine: id Tech 3: ioquake3 1.36 with fs_game missionpack. The Team Arena script-driven UI comes from missionpack/pak3.pk3 vm/ui.qvm (TA 1.32) at the default vm_ui 2 (missionpack/uix86.dll with vm_ui 0), and its menus from missionpack/pak0.pk3
titles.launch_sets: 1920x1080 fullscreen through the same chain as the baseq3 shortcut. Play Team Arena.bat writes missionpack\fleetres.cfg and passes the identical +set values (plus +set fs_game missionpack). missionpack\autoexec.cfg is byte-identical to baseq3's and execs fleetres.cfg last. GAMESYNC writes missionpack\fleetres.cfg (agent/shared/gameres.h:686). Present and correct in the staged tree. PER-TITLE-STATUS has no separate hardware row for the missionpack launch; it is the same engine and cvars as the ioquake3 path measured on .145.
titles.menu_source:
A hardcoded cvarFloatList for r_mode in the menu scripts, both from missionpack/pak0.pk3. pak1-3 do not replace them, and pak3's ui/menus.txt still loads ui/system.menu.
- ui/system.menu line 140 (main menu > Setup > System > Graphics): { "320*240" 0 "400*300" 1 "512*384" 2 "640*480" 3 "800*600" 4 "960*720" 5 "1024*768" 6 "1152*864" 7 "1280*1024" 8 "1600*1200" 9 "2048*1536" 10 "856*480 Wide Screen" 11 }
- ui/ingame_system.menu line 237 (in-game ESC > System) has the same list with 'x' separators.
Neither Team Arena UI module reads r_availableModes: missionpack/uix86.dll and the pak3 ui.qvm contain only 'r_mode'. So vm_ui changes nothing here.
With r_mode -1, the 'Video Mode:' label is EMPTY, because Item_Multi_Setting returns "" for a value that is not in the list, and clicking it jumps to 400x300. Apply only runs vid_restart and does not touch r_mode. A Quality preset (ui_glCustom 0-3) writes r_mode 4 or 3.
titles.evidence:
- Extracts are in .../evidence-1080p/static-quake3-teamarena/teamarena-menus.txt: both itemDefs verbatim, menus.txt (pak3) and ingame.txt (pak0), both Apply actions ('open vid_restart_popmenu', and 'exec "vid_restart"' in the in-game menu).
- missionpack/pak3.pk3!vm/ui.qvm: md5 59cb82218d1d32472851380488501feb, magic 0x12721444. Its strings contain 'cvarTest', 'showCvar', 'hideCvar' and 'cvarFloatList'.
- missionpack/uix86.dll (md5 116ed86aa325ace18e6590d1df9d944c) exports ItemParse_cvarTest/showCvar/hideCvar. The stock createserver.menu uses cvarTest/showCvar/hideCvar 54 times.
- Search order in the 1.36-era files.c FS_AddGameDirectory: a directory's pk3s are searched before its loose files, and missionpack comes before baseq3. A pk3 named after pak3.pk3 therefore wins.
- Web: ioquake/ioq3 @72dea0a184 ui_shared.c: Item_Multi_Setting/FindCvarByValue; Item_Multi_HandleKey requires Rect_ContainsPoint on the relative cursor; PC_Float_Parse accepts '-'. @845de6a960 ui_main.c: ui_glCustom presets write r_mode 4/3; the cursor moves by relative deltas only.
- Fleet q3ta-server (:27962): ~/q3ta-server/.q3a/missionpack/server.cfg line 4 'set sv_pure 0' (fleet-q3-servers-pure.txt).
titles.fix:
Data-only fix: a new pk3, missionpack/zz-fleetres-menus.pk3. It sorts after pak3.pk3, so it has the highest priority, and its name has no parentheses. It holds edited copies of ui/system.menu and ui/ingame_system.menu from missionpack/pak0.pk3, whose Video Mode cvarFloatList gains a -1 entry. fleetres writes r_customwidth/height from the panel at every launch, so -1 is exactly 1920x1080 on the LCDs.

To make the list say '1920x1080' only where that is true, duplicate the Video Mode itemDef at the same rect:
- copy A: 'cvarTest "r_customheight" showCvar { "1080" }' with "1920x1080" -1 ("1920*1080" in system.menu's style);
- copy B: 'cvarTest "r_customheight" hideCvar { "1080" }' with "Custom" -1.
On this fleet FLEETRES only ever writes a 1080-line custom mode as 1920x1080. The minimal variant is a single "Custom" -1 entry.

It survives Apply, because Apply is vid_restart only.

Coverage:
- the main menu, always;
- in a match on the fleet q3ta-server (sv_pure 0);
- on a pure Team Arena server the pk3 is not on its list, so the stock menus appear in the match. There is no kick: .menu reads set no pure-reference flag, and ui.qvm still comes from pak3.

A loose-file variant would also survive pure servers: the launcher copies the menus into %APPDATA%\Quake3\missionpack\ui\. .menu files are exempt from the pure restriction, and the homepath directory is searched before the basepath pk3s. But it is per-user state outside GAMESYNC, so it is not recommended.
titles.fix_source: Already in the tree: extract ui/system.menu and ui/ingame_system.menu from /mnt/retro-share/Files/Games-Library/Quake3-TeamArena/missionpack/pak0.pk3, edit them, and zip them. Write through gvfs and verify each file through /mnt. Nothing needs downloading.
titles.fix_risk: Low. The change is data only; both the pak3 ui.qvm and the native DLL parse it, and it affects only these two menus. One risk: an unbalanced brace breaks the whole menu set, so test on one box first. Quality presets still move r_mode to 800x600 or 640x480, as they do today. There is no multiplayer or pure-server consequence.
titles.hw_check:
1. Launch on .123/.145/.195: EXEC cmd /c start "" /D "C:\Games\Quake3-TeamArena" "Play Team Arena.bat".
2. Confirm 1920x1080 fullscreen: WINLIST shows the 'ioquake3' SDL_app window, or use F11 (screenshotJPEG) and DOWNLOAD from %APPDATA%\Quake3\missionpack\screenshots.
3. Menu path: in a match, ESC > System (the Graphics group opens by default), or main menu Options > Setup > System.
4. The Team Arena menus are mouse-driven. TAB/DOWN plus ENTER can reach the type-1 buttons, but the Video Mode multi changes only with the relative-mouse cursor inside its rect, so the agent cannot cycle it. The in-game System window also closes on any click outside its rect (outOfBoundsClick).
5. The automatable proof is therefore the LABEL: today 'Video Mode:' is blank while r_mode is -1; after the fix it reads 1920x1080 on the LCD boxes.
6. Cycling and Apply need a person. Afterwards, check in the console: after vid_restart, 'r_mode' is -1 and r_customwidth/height are 1920/1080.
7. Check in a match on 192.168.1.132:27962.
8. Delete any screenshots afterwards.
titles.verifier_notes: A side finding for the favourites work, from reading the code only (not verified on a box). scripts/gameindex/favorites.py TITLES maps quake3/ioquake3 only to baseq3\autoexec.cfg (accepts baseq3). The Team Arena server in sync.py LOCAL_SERVERS (port 27962, gamename missionpack) is accepted by no title. Team Arena with fs_game missionpack execs missionpack\autoexec.cfg and keeps its own q3config, so Team Arena's Favorites tab likely gets no managed entries.

titles.title: Quake3-TeamArena - Play Quake III Arena - retail 1.32c.bat (id quake3.exe 1.32c + baseq3)
titles.engine: id Tech 3: retail id quake3.exe 'Q3 1.32c win-x86' (md5 b5cf3dd55e045aac6096ff97379d0cab, byte-identical to Files/Game Updates/quake3-1.32c-win.zip) over baseq3 pak0-pak8
titles.launch_sets: 1920x1080 fullscreen through the same FLEETRES chain. The launcher writes baseq3\fleetres.cfg and runs 'start "" quake3.exe +set r_mode -1 +set r_customwidth %FR_W% +set r_customheight %FR_H% +set r_customaspect 1 ...'. The 1.32c renderer has r_customwidth, r_customheight and r_customaspect and honours r_mode -1. PER-TITLE-STATUS records it measured on .145: quake3.exe at 1920x1080. Present and correct in the staged tree.
titles.menu_source: The same hardcoded table in baseq3/pak8.pk3 vm/ui.qvm (320x240 .. 2048x1536 and '856x480 wide screen'). vm_ui defaults to "2", and CL_InitUI forces the QVM when the server is pure. The engine publishes no r_availableModes (zero hits, case-insensitive), so even a menu that reads it would fall back to the id table. r_mode -1 shows as 640x480, and any Apply writes r_mode 3.
titles.evidence:
- quake3.exe strings: 'Q3 1.32c' @0xb281e; 'Security Warning' @0xbad98 with 'has not been verified for use with Quake III Arena.' @0xbacf5 and 'com_blindlyLoadDLLs' @0xbadac; '%s has bad header' @0xba0a4; 'Mode 11: 856x480 (wide)' @0xbbd88; 'r_customwidth' @0xbc824; 'r_customaspect' @0xbc7fc; no r_availableModes.
- Disassembly: VM_Init @0x439c10 pushes "2" for vm_cgame, vm_game and vm_ui. CL_InitUI @0x4110e0: [0xa59fd4] (pure) gives 2, otherwise Cvar_VariableValue("vm_ui").
- pak8 ui.qvm: see the ioquake3 entry. Both pak8 and the TA pak3 QVMs carry VM_MAGIC 0x12721444 (binaries-md5.txt).
- Web: current ioq3 main sv_init.c SV_TouchFile("vm/ui.qvm") when pure, and sv_client.c SV_VerifyPaks_f drops a client whose ui.qvm pk3 checksum differs ('Unpure Client'). The fleet runs ioq3ded 1.36+u20251228. Current q3_ui appends the current mode only inside 'if (*resbuf)', i.e. only when r_availableModes is non-empty.
- Share search (case-insensitive): Files/Game Updates/quake3e.exe = Quake3e 'Q3 1.32e', with a mode table that reaches 'Mode 19: 1920x1080' and r_mode -2, but no r_availableModes. Files/Games/Mods & Patches/Quake III holds CPMA, OSP, Excessive Plus and DeFRaG, which are separate mod directories. No baseq3 UI replacement exists on the share.
- Evidence files: ui-vm-selection-disasm.txt, source-excerpts-FROM-WEB.txt, binaries-md5.txt in .../evidence-1080p/static-quake3-teamarena/
titles.fix:
There is no config-only route.
- vm_ui 0 would first raise the MB_TOPMOST 'Security Warning' dialog, then load the ioq3-built baseq3/uix86.dll. With no r_availableModes that DLL shows the same 12 modes and maps r_mode -1 to 640x480, so it gains nothing.

The smallest real fix is a patched q3_ui ui.qvm, built from id's GPL 1.32b q3_ui (the source pak8 matches) or from ioquake3's. About 15 lines change:
- The list is r_availableModes when the engine publishes it. Otherwise it is the id table plus 'r_customwidth x r_customheight' when that is not a builtin size; fleetres makes that 1920x1080 on the LCDs at every launch.
- SetMenuItems selects that entry when r_mode is -1.
- Apply maps it to r_mode -1 and leaves r_customwidth/height alone.

Assemble with q3asm -vq3 so the file keeps VM_MAGIC 0x12721444. Retail ERR_FATALs 'vm/ui.qvm has bad header' on a VER2 QVM, which would stop quake3.exe starting at all, including FLEETGL's Voodoo path.

Ship it client-side as baseq3/zz-fleetres-ui.pk3. It then also serves ioquake3 at vm_ui 2, at the main menu and in local games.

Do NOT place it on the pure quake3-server unless every client has it. A client that lacks it would be dropped as 'Unpure Client', and it would not be auto-downloaded unless cl_allowDownload is 1. Kept client-side only, a pure server just falls the client back to pak8's UI in a match, with no kick. With quake3-server at sv_pure 0 the patched UI stays in the match too.

The honest alternative: accept launcher-only 1080p for this A/B shortcut.
titles.fix_source: This would need downloading: the GPL Quake III source (github.com/id-Software/Quake-III-Arena or github.com/ioquake/ioq3, code/q3_ui) plus ioquake3's q3lcc/q3cpp/q3rcc/q3asm tools built on the Linux host. Nothing suitable is on the share (see evidence).
titles.fix_risk:
Moderate.
- It replaces the whole baseq3 UI module for BOTH engines: menus, server browser, favourites (server1..16) and the CD-key menu. Base it on the id 1.32b source to minimise drift.
- The wrong assembler flag leaves retail unable to start.
- GAMESYNC never deletes, so withdrawing the pk3 later needs a delete step in the launchers.
- Placing it on the server makes it mandatory for every client.
titles.hw_check:
1. Launch on .123/.145/.195: EXEC cmd /c start "" /D "C:\Games\Quake3-TeamArena" "Play Quake III Arena - retail 1.32c.bat".
2. Confirm 1920x1080 fullscreen: on XP, WINLIST shows the 'Quake 3: Arena' window at 1920x1080. On .195, use F11 (screenshotJPEG) and DOWNLOAD from C:\Games\Quake3-TeamArena\baseq3\screenshots.
3. Menu: main menu > SETUP > SYSTEM > Video Mode. q3_ui is keyboard-navigable; retail reads the keyboard through WM_KEYDOWN and the mouse through DirectInput.
   - Today it shows 640x480 while the game runs 1920x1080, and RIGHT cycles only the 12 id modes.
   - Optional Apply-trap demonstration: change Texture Detail and Apply; r_mode becomes 3 and the game goes to 640x480. A relaunch restores it.
4. After a QVM fix: the menu shows 1920x1080, Apply keeps r_mode -1, and on a pure server the console shows the connection was not dropped.
5. Delete any screenshots afterwards.
titles.verifier_notes: SERVERS-online.txt in the tree tells players to use a 'Launch Quake3e.bat'. No such file is staged (case-insensitive find); the text is stale. quake3e.exe exists only under Files/Game Updates.
